environment.description: Apache Tomcat 9.0.65 running on EC2 behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4 only). No response header modifications. Application deployed as ROOT.war. SQS queue receives messages from multiple upstream producers including a public-facing form submission service. No output encoding library configured. JVM: OpenJDK 11.0.16. Security Manager disabled. No servlet filters configured for response headers.

config.sqs_producers: public form submission service, internal microservices
